description.value:
You know how to siphon the power hellish deities give devils without offering up worship. You gain the cleric's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Domain Initiate] feat but must select fire, trickery, or tyranny as your domain. You cast that domain's domain spell as a divine focus spell, and you Refocus by reviewing the arguments and clauses in your contract folio.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, selecting a different domain each time.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
